actions.detail: Preflight and WorkPreflight froze snapshot, existing-data upgrade, smoke, forward-fix, restore, and RLS/grant revalidation under the local P03-008 dependency projection.

PostgreSQL client tools were absent from PATH and the broad filesystem fallback timed out after returning the installed pg_dump location. The affected probe was replaced, not repeated, by exact existence and version checks under C:/Program Files/PostgreSQL/17/bin; pg_dump, pg_restore, and psql all reported 17.10.

Added a task-owned local wrapper, a custom-format snapshot/restore rehearsal with logical hashing and advisory-lock proof, and a runbook that preserves forward-only RLS/grant constraints and makes no RPO/RTO claim.
The plan-level locked Python contains governance utilities but not the repository pytest environment, so the first wrapper run stopped before database access with 'No module named pytest'.

The wrapper now uses the repository's dependency-locked agent-service virtual environment and requires its Python 3.13.9 version to equal the sealed toolchain version before execution. No package or database change was needed.

The repaired wrapper completed the full isolated snapshot, existing-data upgrade, smoke, forward-fix rejection, restore, logical-hash comparison, migration-lock, and CT-007 revalidation journey in one passing test.
Added exact P03-009 task-gate adapters without changing Catalog bytes or any Runtime schema/authorization constraint.
The complete Agent CI suite passed with 212 unit/integration tests and 44 contract tests, plus formatting, lint, type, secret, license, dependency-audit, and clock-contract checks.
